Configuration.title: Configure your institution
Configuration.subtitle: Start with a preset, then safely adapt terminology, workflows, grading, attendance and documents.
Configuration.nextStepBody: Preset choices seed editable configuration. Nothing becomes permanent or bypasses approval rules.
Configuration.terminologyBody: Rename visible concepts without changing permissions, APIs or database identifiers.
Configuration.numberingBody: Preview branch, year, document and counter tokens before publishing.
Configuration.workflowBody: Published cases retain their original workflow version while new drafts evolve safely.
